integrity: The count is derived directly from the source's necessary-and-sufficient local-unit criterion and the exact component cardinalities. A standalone exhaustive verifier checks all multiplier tuples for the source's \(m=3\) CRT decomposition at indices \(1,2,3\), including the source seed with only the degree-two factor active.
scientific_limitations: The formula counts ordered multiplier residues for the odd-length squarefree setting of the source theorem. It does not count distinct QC codes up to equality or equivalence, and it does not address the even-length repeated-root case.
title: Exact type-preservation density for one-generator quaternary QC searches
